extensionAttribute.description: Reports whether /etc/pam.d/login includes a smartcard module.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # SmartCard - Login command Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon # Original regex ^1[3-9]$ would fail to match macOS 26 (Tahoe). PAM module # layout is unchanged on every supported macOS.
pam="/etc/pam.d/login"
if [[ ! -f "$pam" ]]; then echo "<result>PAM file missing</result>" exit 0 fi
if /usr/bin/grep -qi 'smartcard' "$pam"; then echo "<result>Enabled</result>" else echo "<result>Disabled</result>" fi
